_comment: Two rosters, both enforced by tools/gate-census.mjs.  `not_in_suite`: gate-shaped tools deliberately NOT run by tools/run-tests.sh — a gate that is neither reachable from the suite nor listed here fails the census, and an entry naming a file that no longer exists fails it too.  A reason must say why the tool CANNOT be green in the suite — 'nobody got round to it' is not one; wire it instead.  `measurement_tools`: tools that produce numbers or artifacts rather than verdicts, so there is nothing for a leg to assert.  That roster is COMPLETE by assertion: every tracked tools/**.{mjs,sh,py} outside tools/lib/ must be gate-shaped, or reachable from the suite, or listed here.  It lived in tools/archaeology/README.md as prose until round 13, where nothing graded it — which is how deploy.sh came to be in neither list, and how the prose came to say 'no leg runs them' about two tools that legs do run.

not_in_suite.reason: why this cannot be a suite leg
not_in_suite.owner: the task that would change that, if any

measurement_tools.produces: what it emits, and for whom

tools/386/run-386box.sh.reason: BLOCKED: needs a FreeDOS disk image and a DOS DOOM.EXE, neither in the repo (docs/386/BRING-UP.md). It also measures id's vanilla DOS binary as a 386 baseline, not this codebase, so it could never gate a change here.

tools/baremetal/run-check.sh.reason: BLOCKED: OS-less ARM under QEMU boots, but per-tic hash streaming over the emulated UART is unresolved (tools/baremetal/README.md, 13.4b residual). Without the hashes there is nothing to assert.

tools/coverage/run-coverage.sh.reason: Produces a coverage REPORT, not a verdict: there is no committed floor to regress against, so wiring it would add runtime and assert nothing. Give it a floor and it becomes a leg.

tools/386/fetch-roms.sh.produces: downloads 86Box BIOS ROMs for the 386DX-40 harness; they are licence-varied and not committed
tools/386/fetch-roms.sh.run: once, before the 386 harness, which is itself registered above as BLOCKED

tools/build-choco-reference.sh.produces: builds an instrumented Chocolate Doom that prints webdoom's per-tic fingerprint
tools/build-choco-reference.sh.run: on demand, to re-take the 44,580-tic cross-validation; needs SDL2, so it cannot be a leg

tools/coverage/parse-gcov.py.run: by the coverage runner, which is registered above: a report, not a verdict

tools/deploy.sh.produces: puts the working tree on the running webdoom.service and restarts it, refusing mid-game
tools/deploy.sh.run: after a server/ or client/ change; it acts on a live host, which is the opposite of what a leg may do

tools/freestanding/cycle-attrib.sh.produces: per-subsystem instruction attribution over the 13 demos into tools/golden/cycle-attribution.json
tools/freestanding/cycle-attrib.sh.run: when the perf split is being re-derived; minutes of qemu, and the output is a table, not a pass

tools/freestanding/cycle-floor.sh.produces: per-tic instruction-count floor per demo into tools/golden/cycle-floor.json, with run-to-run variance
tools/freestanding/cycle-floor.sh.run: same; the committed json is the baseline other documents quote

tools/freestanding/gen-imports.sh.produces: regenerates tools/freestanding/IMPORTS.md from the built fs-doom binary (make imports)
tools/freestanding/gen-imports.sh.run: after a libc-surface change; the committed file is the artifact

tools/freestanding/zone-stats.sh.produces: render-ON zone HWM and purge pressure at ZONESIZE 32 and 4 MiB into tools/golden/zone-stats.json
tools/freestanding/zone-stats.sh.run: when ZONESIZE is re-argued; it builds two extra fs-doom variants

tools/gen-tables.mjs.produces: regenerates engine/core/tables_fix.h, the packed correction stream to 1993-canon trig, plus its boot CRC
tools/gen-tables.mjs.run: after a toolchain or libm change -- and the boot CRC is what tells you one happened

tools/hol-measure.mjs.produces: head-of-line blocking distribution for netplay: bundle inter-arrival gaps against the 28.57 ms tic
tools/hol-measure.mjs.run: on demand; docs/netcode-numbers.md is its output, and it needs two live clients for 15 s

tools/native-sanitize/compare.py.produces: diffs native ASan/UBSan JSON traces against tools/golden/
tools/native-sanitize/compare.py.run: by the native-sanitize runner, which the native-asan leg runs; this half only reports the diff

tools/plane-measure.mjs.run: needs a build compiled with -DWEB_PERF_PLANE_STATS; in a normal build its three exports return 0

tools/rp2040/prep-whd.sh.produces: WHD asset pipeline: lump sizes by category, compression ratios, the RP2040 flash budget
tools/rp2040/prep-whd.sh.run: when the RP2040 arithmetic is revisited; docs/rp2040/BRING-UP.md quotes it

tools/zone-measure.mjs.produces: peak zone usage per IWAD plus __heap_base, the headroom figures in docs/perf.md
tools/zone-measure.mjs.run: on demand; it is where perf-007 and the zone HWM numbers come from
